meta.source: Captures of Battle.net store, account site and desktop app (capture/*/NOTES.md), 2026-10-02

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells below the page: text inputs, selects, the favourite-star chip, the progress-ring centre. Never a full page.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page and window background, and the solid fill behind sticky bars so content scrolls under them cleanly.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: menus, popovers, hover cards, dashboard panel bodies, neutral badges.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Panel header strips, side-nav hover, sticky banners.

tokens.name: surface-highest
tokens.usage: Selected side-nav item fill (with the accent left bar).

tokens.name: border-solid
tokens.usage: 1px border of menus, popovers and hover cards on surface-raised.

tokens.name: neutral-muted
tokens.usage: Offline presence dot, avatar placeholder, inactive state fills. Not for text.

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: White 3%. Passive info panels (fine print, compatibility box) on surface-page.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: White 6%. Card backplates, row hover, selected rows and option cards, search fields, favourites bar.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: White 12%. Secondary buttons, pills, icon buttons, card hover, select hover, progress-ring track.

tokens.name: fill-dark
tokens.usage: Black 24%. Count pills inside list rows.

tokens.name: overlay-strong
tokens.usage: Black 70%. Play badge on video thumbnails, scrims over media.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: White 12%. Menu dividers, panel rules, outlines of unselected option cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: White 18%. Section dividers between page sections, subtle hover rings.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: White 36%. Input and select borders at rest, tertiary button ring on hover.

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: White 84%. Input and select borders on hover; checkbox outline at rest.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, titles, active labels, prices. On every surface token and on fill/fill-strong.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: White 84%. Running text and paragraphs on surface-page, surface-raised and surface-strong.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: White 72%. Descriptions, labels, idle nav items, menu items, genre lines. Passes 4.5:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: White 60%. Idle tabs, helper text, input placeholders, breadcrumb current page.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: White 48%. Timestamps, eyebrow labels in the app, offline names, subtle links. 4.8:1 on surface-page, 4.6:1 on surface-strong; keep it 12px+ and off fills.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: White 36%. Disabled labels and nav items only (exempt from contrast).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button and CTA fill, text selection. Text on it is on-accent (white 4.6:1+ in the dark-fill themes, ink 6:1+ in teal and orange).

tokens.name: accent-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed and disabled fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, focus borders, selection indicators (tab underline, nav left bar, active dash, active thumbnail frame), checkbox tick, slider fill. 4.5:1+ on surface-page in every theme.

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: Primary button hover ring (2px inset), link hover colour.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Names of online people (friends list, profile header, hover card). Text on surface-page and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill and accent-fill-pressed. Never hard-code white on the accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Online dot, installed check, enabled status, positive badge fill, balance amount, completed progress. As text on surface-page only.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill (NEW badge).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Notice fill, callout text on product cards (release dates, offers), favourited star, away dot.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning fill (product notice).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Urgent badge fill (PRE-PURCHASE, BETA), busy dot. Fill only: as text it is 3.5:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (5.1:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status: alert icons, info toast strip. A status colour, so it stays blue in every accent theme.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of an info alert on surface-page.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of an info alert.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of a success alert.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of a success alert.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Icon strip of a success toast (icon in on-inverse).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of a warning alert.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of a warning alert.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of an error alert.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of an error alert.

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Icon strip of an error toast (icon in on-danger, 7.4:1).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toast body: the one light surface, so a toast stands out over any dark screen.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse (12:1) and on the info, success-strong and warning toast strips.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Black 80% backdrop behind dialogs and the lightbox, with a 20px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: focus-outer
tokens.usage: Outer 2px of the keyboard focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-inner
tokens.usage: Inner 2px gap of the keyboard focus ring, so it reads on light media too.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: feature and download sections.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page title in dashboards (account, settings pages); progress-ring value.

styles.name: heading-xxl
styles.usage: Product title on the detail page.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Section headings, news-row titles, horizontal card titles.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Hero slide headline, banner heading, panel titles, carousel section titles in the app.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Card titles, option-card names, feature-card titles.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Small headings, dialog sub-titles.

styles.name: heading-xs
styles.usage: Video-card titles, dense tile titles.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Franchise line above card titles, section kickers. Always uppercase, text-secondary.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, bar labels (FAVORITES), settings group labels. Always uppercase; text-muted or text-secondary.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Top-level app tabs. Uppercase; 700 when active, 500 when idle.

styles.name: button-xl
styles.usage: The one hero action of a screen (Install, Play, Pre-purchase in the purchase panel).

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Default button label (40px buttons).

styles.name: button-md
styles.usage: 32px buttons, dialog footers.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: 24–26px buttons and pills.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on cards and option cards.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: Digits inside countdown tiles.

styles.name: body-xl
styles.sample: Download the app and join a community of millions.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under display-xl.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Continue the fight with a new campaign.
styles.usage: Large descriptions in hero blocks.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: War erupts on the peninsula as a new campaign begins.
styles.usage: Running text, setting titles, side-nav items, input values.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Allow this account to appear in friends of friends suggestions.
styles.usage: Descriptions, menu items, card callouts, notices, list rows.

styles.name: body-sm-strong
styles.usage: Inline links, selected list rows, emphasised labels.

styles.name: body-xs
styles.usage: Genres, timestamps, fine print, presence activity.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight chips, badge group gap, label to description.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Small vertical rhythm inside banners (heading to subheading).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, pills and thumbnails; menu padding; label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Carousel slide gap, icon-to-label in nav rows, field padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter, card padding (small), heading to grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Option-card and notice horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap, gap between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel header padding, section heading to content, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Panel horizontal padding, row gap in cover grids.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Column gap between the main column and a side column.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical padding between page sections.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Large feature-section gaps.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Menu items, compact filter rows, countdown tiles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, pills, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default: buttons, inputs, cards, media, menus, badges.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Dashboard panels (two-tone card).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Rare: large banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Store dropdown menus and nav buttons.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, presence dots, play badges, count pills.

shadow.note: Elevation is used sparingly: surfaces separate by fill, not shadow. Rings are inset box-shadows so hover never shifts layout.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Small raised chips over media.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Menus and dropdown lists.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hover cards and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Portrait game covers in grids.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: A table header or bar once it sticks.

tokens.name: ring-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover: a 2px accent-ring inside the edge. The fill does not change.

tokens.name: ring-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary and tertiary button hover.

tokens.name: ring-subtle-hover
tokens.usage: Pills, filled icon buttons and app chrome buttons on hover.

tokens.name: ring-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary button and outlined key-binding button at rest.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: 2px focus-inner gap, then 2px focus-outer.

duration.note: Hovers are fast and colour-only. Nothing slides or bounces.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Card backplate hover in the store.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Default for every hover: colour, background, ring, scale of cover tiles.

tokens.name: duration-medium
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers fading in, arrows appearing over media.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Banner dismiss, sticky bar slide.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default easing for hovers and fades.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Ring fade-in on buttons, favourites lift.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, ghost icon buttons in tight rows.

tokens.name: control-pill
tokens.usage: Quick-link pills, back and forward buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Medium buttons, selects in the app, arrow buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Default buttons and text inputs.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Hero action (Install, Pre-purchase panel buttons), list rows with avatars.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; the container adds space-4 gutters each side (1632 total) and centres.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Vertical side navigation in dashboards.

tokens.name: aside-width
tokens.usage: Purchase side column on detail pages.

tokens.name: z-docked
tokens.usage: Arrows and badges docked over media.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky section headers and breadcrumb bars.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Bottom announcement banner, back-to-top.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdown lists, hover cards.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.
